corrections.text: The Overview quotes Google's post as saying the model is "generally available across the Gemini API and Gemini for business". Google's own Cloud blog (November 6, 2026) lists availability in Google Vids but says "coming soon to Gemini for business" and "Coming soon to Gemini, business users will be able to create a short video from a prompt or a product photo, right in the chat." The article does not report this difference between the two Google pages; general availability on Vertex (launch stage GA) and the Gemini API is stated by Google's documentation and posts.

The audio-input paragraph contrasts the model documentation ("Not supported") with the pricing page, Google's post and the Cloud blog, but does not mention that Google DeepMind's model card also lists audio among the model's inputs ("Text strings (e.g., a question, a prompt), images, audio, and video files."). Google's pages therefore disagree three ways on audio input, and the article reports them without reconciliation.
